analysis:
PM Narendra Modi launched 5G services on 1 October 2022 at the India Mobile Congress and said it would not take time to reach everyone.

PIB reported 5G available in 99.6% of districts and about 4.69 lakh 5G base transceiver stations installed as on 28 February 2025. By 31 October 2025, PIB reported 5G in 99.9% of districts with 85% population coverage and about 5.08 lakh base stations. The Department of Telecommunications describes the rollout as among the fastest globally.

District coverage reached near-universal levels within about three years of launch, so the statement is recorded as true, while noting that population coverage was 85% as of late 2025.
notes: The PM's remark is quoted by The Hindu; no full transcript was read, so quote_is_verbatim is false. 'Reach everyone' is not defined with a metric; district coverage (99.9%) and population coverage (85%) are both reported.
